newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady to lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at steady to lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to lower levels on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- 10 barges, two each week of June, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, bid 130 percent of tariff, down 2-1/2 percentage points from May 13, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of July, bid 100 percent of tariff, unchanged from May 13, offer 107-1/2 percent, no comparison.
- Four barges, Ohio River, one each week of July, bid 100 percent, unchanged from May 13, no offer.
- Five barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of August, bid 115 percent, unchanged from May 13, offer 125 percent, no comparison.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of September, bid 150 percent, unchanged from May 13, no offer.
